title: Guided Activation Hub — Docked Snippets & Micro-Labs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a lightweight, composable 'Activation Hub' that surfaces docked onboarding snippets and micro-labs inside the Redwood Console. Goal: reduce time-to-first-success by guiding users through a minimal set of activation tasks (create API key, deploy a sample model, view cost preview) without leaving context. Docked snippets should be small interactive widgets that expand into ephemeral micro-labs; they persist as collapsible rails in the console until dismissed. Emphasis on progressive disclosure, low cognitive load, and shipping tracked education that ties to rollout templates and cost literacy. This ticket captures the prototype, design review notes, accessibility pass, metrics plan, and handoff artifacts for engineering.
acceptance_criteria: Activation Hub appears on first-run for new orgs and in ‘Help -> Get Started’ for returning users
Three docked snippets implemented: API key setup, sample deploy (1-click), cost preview card
Each snippet has an expand/collapse state, progress state, and dismiss action; state persists per-user for 30 days
Micro-lab flows include inline code snippets, example prompts, and a ‘Try with sample prompt’ button that streams output
Telemetry events fire for show/expand/complete/dismiss and map to product metrics dashboard
Design assets and prototype (Figma & InVision) handed to ENG with component tokens and edge-case notes
A11y audit passed for keyboard navigation, focus management, and color contrast
Client-side performance budget validated: initial hub bundle < 60KB gzipped; lazy-load micro-lab engines

decisions: Use a docked right-rail pattern rather than modal to avoid context switching and to make cost metrics visible while using console features.
Micro-labs will be ephemeral if launched from the hub and will not create project artifacts unless user explicitly saves (reduces accidental resource creation).
Persist per-user hub state in user-profile metadata; org-level telemetry aggregated for KPIs.
Default show policy: show on first-org sign-up, re-show after major product updates, and via manual entry-point in Help menu.

Design: Localize copy early (EN/FR/DE) for the first iteration and ensure line-lengths work at 14px.

accessibility_considerations: Keyboard-only discovery: hub must be reachable via main Nav + H hotkey and focus-managed when expanded.
Screen reader announcements: use aria-live polite for ephemeral status updates (e.g., 'Micro-lab complete').
Color contrast: pass AA for text and icons; ensure focus ring is visible at 2px minimum.
tradeoffs: Docked rail preserves context but consumes horizontal space on narrow screens; mitigation: collapsible compact mode for widths < 980px.
Embedding a live simulator would increase time-to-interactive; chosen path: staged rollout where simulator is lazy-loaded after initial success metrics.
Persisting hub state per-user simplifies UX but adds user-profile writes; TTL chosen to reduce long-term storage and accidental preference retention.
